subject: PO fields, invoice cadence, and programmatic discounting
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <h.lee@aurelialabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajesh Menon <r.menon@aurelialabs.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: PO format + quarterly billing cadence question

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Aurelia's infrastructure team was impressed with the latency profile. Procurement has a few follow-ups before we can route a PO: they need a certified list of required PO header fields (our ERP will reject anything missing), confirmation on whether Redwood can do quarterly consolidated invoicing (one invoice per quarter for multiple subscriptions), and whether there are holdback clauses you require for initial onboarding.

Also: our finance team prefers Net-60 for new vendors. Is that something Redwood can accept for the first 12 months, or would you require Net-30/Net-45? We are also evaluating a programmatic discount tied to committed usage: 5% at $400k ARR / 10% at $800k ARR. Would discounts be implemented as a credit on invoices or via modified pricing on the contract?

I attached our standard PO template (Aurelia_PO_template_v2.pdf) to illustrate the fields we need. Please let me know who on your side should own the PO-field mapping so we can avoid ERP rejection.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Lee
Sr. Procurement Manager, Aurelia Labs
---
Attachment: Aurelia_PO_template_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Lee <h.lee@aurelialabs.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format + quarterly billing cadence question

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear note and the template. Looping in Vivek (account executive) and Karthik (finance) to validate the PO mapping and payment terms.

Quick answers at a high level:
- Required PO fields: we can accept PO ID, billing entity, remit-to address, tax ID, and line-item SKU mapping. I will attach a CSV mapping of our internal invoice fields to common PO headers.
- Invoice cadence: quarterly consolidated invoicing is possible; we typically do monthly, but consolidation to quarterly for enterprise customers is a supported option and will be reflected in the SOW.
- Holdbacks: Plymouth (onboarding holdback) is not standard for us — we can discuss an acceptance milestone (e.g., onboarding health check) that triggers final invoicing for the initial quarter.
- Net terms: Karthik, can we confirm whether Net-60 for the first 12 months is acceptable? If not full Net-60, can we do Net-45 with a procurement-signed commitment?
- Programmatic discounts: we generally implement tiered committed-discounts as invoice credits applied retroactively each quarter (easier for accounting), but pricing can be adjusted on the contract if you prefer predictability. Vivek — thoughts on how your customers prefer to see this?

I'll send the field mapping CSV shortly. If procurement wants a short mutual action plan (MAP) and milestone acceptance criteria to attach to the PO/SOW, we can draft that quickly.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood-po-field-mapping.csv (csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Lee <h.lee@aurelialabs.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format + quarterly billing cadence question

Sofia / Vivek — looping in formally to confirm finance stance.

We can accept Net-60 for the first 12 months on a case-by-case basis for new customers >= $250k ARR. For Aurelia (expected TCV > $400k), that fits our risk band. A couple stipulations:
1) We require a signed PO referencing the Redwood billing entity and SOW ID.
2) The PO must include the remit-to address and the vendor tax ID as discrete fields — otherwise our AP team will be unable to match.
3) If you opt for quarterly consolidated invoicing, payments will be due Net-60 from invoice date; for any usage-based overages billed after quarter close, we'll include a short line-item for reconciliation.

On discounts: implementing as retroactive credits is preferred (keeps monthly/quarterly invoices readable). Example: if Aurelia hits the $400k committed threshold in Q3, a quarterly credit will be applied in Q4 to reflect the 5% commitment on the run rate. If Aurelia prefers line-item discounting, we can rework the pricing schedule in the contract but that adds complexity to mid-term amendments.

I'll attach a brief finance checklist that you can pass to Aurelia procurement to speed ERP onboarding.

Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: finance-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Hannah Lee <h.lee@aurelialabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajesh Menon <r.menon@aurelialabs.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format + quarterly billing cadence question

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from procurement after reviewing Karthik's checklist:

- PO ID mapping: Aurelia's ERP requires both a top-level PO number and a subsidiary line PO code for multi-entity billing. Sophia/Vivek, can you confirm the exact field names Redwood will emit on the invoice so our ERP team can map them?
- Acceptance milestone: procurement liked the onboarding health check approach. Could you propose one or two objective criteria (e.g., end-to-end throughput test at p95 < 220ms + two successful model deployments) we can sign into the MAP?
- Credits vs. contract discount: Aurelia prefers invoice-line discounts for internal reporting, but they're open to retro credits if Redwood's accounting team flags concerns. Monica, can you weigh in on any legal ramifications of applying retroactive credits vs. contract amendments?

We attached a signed (redacted) sample PO in a follow-up — we're close on paperwork and want to keep momentum. Can Vivek confirm who will own the MAP doc and send a first draft by EOD Friday?

Best,
Hannah
Sr. Procurement Manager, Aurelia Labs
---
Attachment: Aurelia_PO_sample_signed_redacted.pdf (pdf)
